scope: Only the two existing schematic pages; no PCB/panel work.
ercStatus: One warning remains in the full schematic. Detail unavailable through v3.2 API; native UI access was not approved. Do not classify this revision as manufacturing-ready.
changes: Q1 Si2323DS-T1-E3 -> Si2323DDS-T1-GE3, pin map preserved.
U2 TPS7A4901DGNR; OUT1 FB2 NC3 GND4 EN5 NR/SS6 DNC7 IN8 EP9. Nominal 1.185*(1+34k/10k)=5.214V.
DAC gain resistors: 100k/24.3k, Susumu RG1608N 0.05%, 10ppm/C, manual procurement.
DAC-control pull-ups now use DAC AVDD; TTL/Ioff buffers and default-muted output relay added.
+12V/AVDD/-12V power-good supervision added; negative domain uses optocoupler.
Page 2 DAC_MCU has two SMA receiver/buffer/difference-amplifier channels, tracking external MCU VREF+. Separate input/output relay enables.
limitations: Prior output/validated-revision projects are superseded and must not be used for fabrication. Their TPS7A49 mapping was incorrect.
The MCU receiver assumes external VDDA/VREF+=3.3V, high-Z output loading, common ground. No 50-ohm termination.
Source-side cable driver may be needed to meet the MCU DAC CL<=50pF condition.
Relay release is not an instantaneous clamp on unexpected power loss.
AVDD overshoot, power-rail/output transients, effective capacitor values, thermal performance, cable stability, load capability and calibrated accuracy need physical qualification.
PCB is intentionally unchanged and does not implement the revised schematic.
R5/inductor/compensation conditional qualifications still require input-slew and load measurements.
